Headline: #7 Harrison buses Temporary Reroute near Harrison/Albany
ShortDescription: #7 Harrison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction near Harrison/Albany.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#7 Harrison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction near Harrison/Albany.

Westbound buses will operate via Harrison, Sacramento, Jackson, Kedzie, Congress and then resume their normal route.

Eastbound buses will operate via Harrison, Kedzie, Jackson, Sacramento, Harrison and then resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.
